companies.title: Businesses and Municipalities
companies.body: Our solution allows municipalities and businesses to strengthen sustainable textile management through a system of separate collection and circular economy. Municipalities benefit from diverting more textile waste from landfill, improved recycling rates and access to environmental impact data through digital dashboards. Businesses, in turn, can earn Circularity Credits linked to textile collection and recovery, supporting emissions offsetting and more transparent, measurable ESG reporting.

individuals.title: Individuals
individuals.body: Do you have clothes you no longer wear? Give them a new purpose. Through its separate textile collection service, RETEX channels garments in good condition towards reuse, helping to reduce waste and promote the circular economy.

about.title: Who are we?
about.body1: We are RETEX, a platform that is revolutionising the way we deal with textile waste. We make textile reuse simpler, more convenient and more efficient through an innovative collection model and a genuine commitment to the circular economy.
about.body2: We connect consumers, businesses and municipalities to give textiles a new life, reduce waste and generate positive environmental and social impact.

collection.title: Sustainable Collection
collection.text: In Portugal there are more than 200 thousand tonnes. The problem is growing, but we have a solution.

waste.title: Reducing Textile Waste
waste.text: We give every garment a new life, keeping tonnes of textiles out of landfill.

impact.title: Social and Environmental Impact
impact.text: We support social causes and sustainable practices to reduce our ecological footprint.

circular.title: Circular Economy
circular.text: We turn waste into resources, promoting more conscious consumption.

quote.body: Recycling is recognising that everything has value and deserves a second life.

upcycling.banner: THIS PIECE WAS REINVENTED FROM REUSED MATERIALS
upcycling.title: Giving materials a new life
upcycling.body: At RETEX, upcycling is the most creative way to extend the life of textiles. Instead of going to waste, production offcuts, surplus stock and old uniforms are transformed into new, higher-value products — accessories, homeware and corporate gifts.
